overview: The Corrupted Grove is the first major zone where Shadow Valley’s corruption becomes overwhelming.
history: The grove was once a thriving valley ecosystem.
Shadow fractures spread into the grove after Akhevan rituals intensified.
Flora mutated into void-scar variants, feeding on shadow energy.
Akhevan ritual pylons were erected to accelerate corruption.
hooks: A void-scar tree begins to pulse violently.
Akhevan ritual pylons activate in sequence.
A scout reports the grove expanding unnaturally.
